dsh-ble.en: BLE service over the system capability plane: scan, connect, GATT — consent and audit live host-side.
dsh-ble.zh: 系统能力面上的 BLE 服务：扫描、连接、GATT——同意与审计由宿主侧承担。

dsh-device-plane.en: Device service plane: device info, haptics, clipboard, share sheet, keep-awake over frozen primitives.
dsh-device-plane.zh: 设备服务面：设备信息、震动、剪贴板、分享面板、保持唤醒，全部走冻结原语。

dsh-fs.en: The fs service (read/write/append/exists/stat) over fsRead/fsWrite/fsScope; scope-relative paths, escapes rejected.
dsh-fs.zh: fs 服务(读/写/追加/存在/状态)，基于 fsRead/fsWrite/fsScope;作用域相对路径，越界即拒。

dsh-office.en: The word/excel/ppt document plane: create/read/update documents and create/read presentations.
dsh-office.zh: word/excel/ppt 文档面：创建/读取/更新文档，创建/读取演示文稿。

dsh-open-design.en: Open Design daemon REST surface (projects, BYOK generate, artifact save/lint) over httpFetch.
dsh-open-design.zh: Open Design 守护进程 REST 面(项目、BYOK 生成、产物保存与 lint),走 httpFetch。

dsh-shell-ish.en: The shell capability over contract ishRun: a real Linux userland emulated in-process.
dsh-shell-ish.zh: shell 能力走契约 ishRun:进程内模拟的真实 Linux 用户态。

dsh-shell-wasm.en: The shell capability over contract wasmRun: the workspace is the PATH, programs are .wasm, interpreted in-process.
dsh-shell-wasm.zh: shell 能力走契约 wasmRun:工作区即 PATH,程序即 .wasm,进程内解释执行。

dsh-subprocess-quickjs.en: ctx.subprocess — the coroutine executor: event-driven spawn handles, no OS processes, nothing blocking.
dsh-subprocess-quickjs.zh: ctx.subprocess——协程执行器：事件驱动的 spawn 句柄，无 OS 进程，无阻塞。

dsh-ui.en: The ui service: approval dialogs, pickers and notifications composed from the presentation primitives.
dsh-ui.zh: ui 服务：由展示原语组合出的审批对话框、选择器与通知。
